g.text: PULSIPHER FARMS / ACCESSIBLE COACH DETAIL DEVELOPMENT
Attached guards, rear curtain and tether routing
C3.1 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
REAR GAP CURTAIN · ACTUAL CLAMPS AND THREE PRESCRIBED SHAPES
Continuous flexible-sheet candidate; these are geometry states, not a material simulation.
ATTACHED SIDE GUARDS + PARKED LOSS-PREVENTION CABLE
Four stand-offs and screws per cover; parked cotter remains physically present.
DETAIL
NOMINAL CANDIDATE
Active curtain length / thickness
Clamped width Y
Modeled centerline bend radius
Cable working centerline
8.5; prescribed engaged/parked routes
Cotter eye clear opening
Oval 0.625 × 0.25 at45° inYZ
Small nominal eye clearances
~0.045 pan-side / ~0.044 cheek-top
The curtain has real fixed/moving clamp bars, threaded backers and fasteners; active sheet shape changes through the19-angle check.
Cable moves between open-top routing saddles and a closed slack tray. Flexible snag, vibration escape, swage and glove-use behavior remain unverified.
Nominal rigid/curve clearance is not proof of finger exclusion. Guard probe tests, material/fire selection and operating mockups remain required.
Back/seat upholstery retention, finished edge treatments and the complete maintenance procedure remain controlled open items.
